components.name: Tactile Primary Button
components.description: High-contrast action trigger with crimson fill and glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #E62429; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 14px 28px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.2); box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(230,36,41,0.5); transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Secondary Ghost Button
components.description: Tactical telemetry button with carbon substrate and hairline stroke.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: rgba(13,13,13,0.8); color: #D0D0D0; border: 1px solid #2A2A2A; border-radius: 4px; padding: 14px 28px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; backdrop-filter: blur(8px); transition: all 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #E62429; color: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(230,36,41,0.4); }

narrative.overview: The Marvel Cinematic Universe Archive is an in-universe tactical intelligence interface built for Earth-616 hero reconnaissance. The aesthetic fuses aerospace carbon composite density, high-contrast dark-mode surfaces, classified military typography stamps, and reactive WebGL particle illumination.
keyCharacteristics: In-Universe Tactical Atmosphere: Precision gridlines, scanline textures, HUD coordinates, and authentic classification identifiers.
Volumetric Holo-Depth: Three.js WebGL particle systems and 3D card tilt physics create tangible physical weight.
Disciplined Palette Restraint: Pure carbon canvas, vivid scarlet accents, and golden rank marks without color pollution.
Kinetic Micro-Interactions: Pill docks, laser stat meters, glowing hairline borders, and smooth hero cross-fades.

rules.name: The Rarity of Red Rule
rules.body: Marvel Crimson is never used as background wallpaper or large decorative fills; its power stems strictly from high-contrast focus on actionable controls, key stamps, and pulse indicators.

rules.name: The Sovereign Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold is strictly decorative and hierarchical—it denotes tier, clearance, and alter-ego identity, never arbitrary UI borders or buttons.

rules.name: The Monospace Telemetry Rule
rules.body: Every data point, attribute metric, security clearance, and technical tag must be rendered in Space Grotesk with letter-spacing >= 0.1em and uppercase styling.

rules.name: The Layered Holo-Depth Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest flush on carbon grids; elevation is triggered dynamically by pointer proximity, unleashing 3D perspective rotation, border gradient illumination, and particle refraction.

dos: Do preserve the #080808 canvas to maintain infinite contrast for Three.js particles and neon glows.
Do format all telemetry data, badges, and metrics in uppercase Space Grotesk with letter-spacing >= 0.1em.
Do maintain smooth cross-fade transitions when switching between heroes (coordinated text, backdrops, and particles).
Do keep gold #F5C518 strictly confined to alter-egos, ratings, and threat tiers.
Do ensure all interactions provide keyboard accessibility and touch swipe equivalents.
donts: Don't introduce solid colored background sections; all surfaces must be dark carbon substrates.
Don't use generic rounded buttons or playful bubbly shapes; maintain tactical aerospace geometry.
Don't dilute Marvel Crimson with secondary competing warm tones (e.g. orange or magenta).
Don't use standard browser fonts or unstyled serif typefaces.
Don't block user interactions during 3D particle rendering or background cross-fades.
